focus: catalog stable identity and append-only restart recovery
zero-byte versus partial cleanup quarantine append failure

summary: The SDD withdraws the unsupported writable-VFS/direct-handle claim and accurately specifies canonical-path modernc SQLite open with post-open diagnostic identity check before application SQL, explicitly excluding same-account/open-stage page access races. Protected parent ACL/mode and held handles protect against other accounts. Cleanup append failure recovery distinguishes zero-byte failure (no deletion, current process fail closed, restart may revalidate/retry from complete old catalog) from partial/uncertain tail (global fail closed, no rollback). The acceptance matrix covers both branches. No new security blocker was found in the written boundary.

round14_dispositions.evidence: §3 says zero-byte cleanup_quarantined append/Sync failure causes no deletion and current-supervisor global fail-closed; on restart a complete old chain is authoritative and cleanup can be safely rechecked/retried. Partial tail/format/sequence/uncertain Sync causes global fail-closed without rollback. §6 acceptance matrix injects both cases.

§3 no longer claims direct verified-handle consumption by writable modernc VFS. It specifies canonical-path mode=rw open, no auto-create/ping/query, post-open PRAGMA database_list plus OS file-ID diagnostic before app SQL/receipt access, and explicitly disclaims pre-open/page-read and same-account race protection. External-account replacement is blocked by ACL/mode and handle rules.

control_dispositions.sqlite_open_identity_contract: coherent under explicit restricted threat model; runtime path/page-access behavior not verified
control_dispositions.catalog_stable_inode_acl_append_only: sufficient against other principals under protected parent ACL; trusted same-account tampering excluded
control_dispositions.catalog_restart_recovery: complete old chain may revalidate/retry cleanup after zero-byte failure; partial/uncertain chain globally fails closed
control_dispositions.critical_file_races: specified for parent ACL/mode, Windows held handles, links/path identity, auxiliary files, sidecar/key
control_dispositions.per_case_key_and_privacy: fresh independent CSPRNG key; protected delivery and log minimization retained
control_dispositions.data_lifecycle: retention, quarantine, grouped deletion, and tombstone order retained

limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No SQLite connection/page-access experiment, ACL/file-race, catalog fault injection, browser request, database, or restart path was executed.
Approval is limited to the written test-only design under its declared trusted-local-account boundary; it does not establish implementation correctness, production readiness, or classroom readiness.
